hooks.text: 八名玩家在丛林地图争夺积分，最终由最高分而非单纯存活决定胜者
hooks.excerpt: The game has 8 players, who fight in a jungle map, and the one with the highest score wins the game.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 局内持续拼装技能组合，可把一系列技能连接成额外效果
hooks.excerpt: Players need to constantly build their own skill combinations through development during the game process, achieving a series of skills with additional effects.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 技能、攻击与护甲类型、英雄天赋形成三层克制，后期不存在固定无敌套路
hooks.excerpt: Game Features Skills rivalry: there is a clear mutual restraint between skills Type Restriction: The restriction of attack type and armor type (applicable to all damage) Talent Incompatibility: Heroes have different talents, which are mutually incompatible The above three situations may vary depending on the circumstances, so there is no fixed so-called invincible routine in the later stages.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
